basis.claim: The comparable Deere pack is essentially empty — no thesis, management, peers, model or figures landed — so no evidence supports preferring it over the subject.
Fit scores for both names are not measured on both presets, so no factor-based discrimination is possible.
Boeing's own evidence shows a genuine inflection: revenue rose to $89.5bn with operating income swinging positive to $4.3bn and operating cash flow back to +$1.1bn on higher deliveries.

Quality of that improvement is weak — adjusted EBITDA was still negative $3.9bn, free cash flow was negative $1.9bn, book value per share remains below zero, and the headline earnings jump was driven by a one-off $9.6bn divestiture gain.
Execution risk remains live: rate increases require FAA concurrence, 737-7/-10 certification is still pending, BCA lost $7.1bn in 2025, and $8.5bn of debt is due within twelve months.
Backlog across all segments expanded materially, giving the subject a measurable forward-demand anchor that the comparable pack cannot match or contradict.
